column2: triage can investigate or publicly mutate security-sensitive issues without the fail-closed handling used by `/bug`.
the concurrent-update contract does not specify the timestamp field, comparison behavior, or protection across multiple mutations.
the new structural harness may be treated as a dead script by ci.
a `--repo` target differing from the checkout can cause code verification against the wrong repository and produce false verdicts.
dependency mutation can report success without verifying that the required blocked-by edge exists.
copied issue, evidence, or comment text can inject machine-parsed larch plan or pause markers into published triage content.
a valid-verdict rewrite can destroy active design, implement, clarify, pause, or plan state.
the cli and follow-up invocations do not pin the `--operator-invoked` boundary, risking unauthorized direct mutation.
unvalidated issue-supplied refs or paths can cause option injection, traversal, unintended fetches, or secret-file disclosure.
a single initial freshness check cannot protect later mutations in a multi-step verdict sequence.
missing evidence or repository mismatch currently forces an unjustified verdict or an inappropriate issue close.
prompt-only reproduction rules can execute issue-supplied shell expansion, destructive actions, secret exfiltration, or externally mutating requests.
dependency application may target the checkout default instead of the repository selected for triage.
`--report-only` may emit only terminal verdict keys instead of the requested evidence, diagnosis, and fix analysis.
token-only sanitization can publish secrets, internal urls, pii, temporary paths, or control markers from evidence and repro output.
logs, git output, code excerpts, and reproduction output are not consistently isolated from instructions embedded in untrusted evidence.
triage can halt after child skills return, skipping dependency read-back, follow-up verification, cleanup, and terminal machine keys.
investigation may inspect a feature branch or dirty worktree instead of main, producing false fixed or root-cause conclusions.
the required fetch-and-show workflow for unmerged branch evidence has no reachable, validated cli surface.
dependency application can use stale analysis after an intervening issue edit or lifecycle transition.
rejecting lifecycle-prefixed titles before verdict routing makes required title restoration unreachable for already-fixed or duplicate issues.
a blanket ban on networked or authenticated probes prevents the specified safe external-tool reproduction path.
